t-line.text: Line: one line of work, opened

s-line.text: One column, read top to bottom in order of importance: the head (where it stands, done when, its moves), what needs you, the summary, the plan with its issues and pull requests, what happened, the owner, then Tell. Nothing sits in an empty right column. A section with nothing in it says why in one sentence instead of showing a bare heading.

t-question.text: Question: one thing only you can answer

s-question.text: Three zones, always in this order: what is asked (read), your answer (decide), other ways out (own words, later). A hairline and space separate reading from deciding. Each option is a real control: its number sits on the label's baseline, at the label's size. The reason for the recommendation lives inside the recommended option.
